spec_deviations.deviation: mechanism_backend default is MIRROR, not ENGINE_BRIDGE
spec_deviations.reason: task constraint 'existing tests/test_fact_surrogate.py still passes untouched' pins build_mechanism's pre-L2-2 call shape (torch-generator-only, no seed_root); an ENGINE_BRIDGE default would turn those 20 existing tests into errors. MIRROR default keeps every pre-existing caller byte-identical while production through-M arms (E-5 frozen configs) select ENGINE_BRIDGE explicitly and auditable in the hashed config payload. This is the conservative reading of 'keeping the mirror as the documented fallback for tests'.

spec_deviations.deviation: inference-draw seeding for ENGINE_BRIDGE roots the E-3 TrainKernelStream at the derived integer of substream kernel:k (rather than training-style rooting at the run seed root)
spec_deviations.reason: E-3 exposes only stream-or-seed_root hook construction; rooting all 16 draws at the run root would make them identical, violating C2(b) 'derived spawn(seed, kernel, k), k=1..16'. Rooting each draw's stream at its kernel:k node keeps draws distinct, namespaced and replay-identical across cells; documented in build_inference_mechanism and pinned by the hand-built kernel:k equality test.

spec_deviations.deviation: bridge-PAM forward is the engine's exact clearing (noise affects only the backward mask), unlike mirror-PAM whose forward is the perturbed clearing
spec_deviations.reason: E-3's frozen contract ('forward is ALWAYS the engine output; the perturbed clearing supplies only the backward mask'). L2-2 consumes the shared layer as-is; tests assert bridge-PAM == engine law, never bridge-PAM == mirror-PAM forward.

interface_notes: executing the ENGINE_BRIDGE path requires scripts/ importable (lab_asset package) - tests insert it on sys.path; E-5 production wiring must do the same

the E-3 stream is stateful (one estimator-blind child per mechanism call): two mechanisms built from the same root replay identically only from equal call counts; fresh construction per arm/step-evaluation is the supported pattern
build_inference_mechanism deliberately constructs under enforcement=THROUGH_M so raw-trained cells evaluated under through-M inference (contract C3 cells (t,e)) get mechanisms too
engine bridge runs at E-3's NOMINAL_LEVEL_PRICE=1; cash channels at true prices are composed by RecurrentFactSurrogate from slot prices, unchanged
